question: Where is gold moving as money?
answer: The world record holds 16 dated gold and reserve moves in 9 regions, January 30, 2025 to September 4, 2026. The newest that is not a social post: the PBoC reports its twentieth straight month of gold buying — 14.93 tonnes in June, the biggest monthly add since 2023, holdings near 2,346 tonnes. (China, July 7, 2026). Tonnages appear only inside each record's text; the master has no buy, sell or tonnage column.

items.title: A good reminder on how finance still works today… the Central Bank of Netherlands just spent months moving $11B in gold from New York to London. ~70% of it never actually left the ground.
items.text: A good reminder on how finance still works today… the Central Bank of Netherlands just spent months moving $11B in gold from New York to London. ~70% of it never actually left the ground. It was sold in NYC and repurchased in London. This reminded me of a story from 2013 – Germany took four years (!!) to move 674 tons of gold, worth $36 billion from vaults in Paris and New York. In the 10+ years between those two stories, crypto went from a $1.5B experimen

items.title: The ECB's own report confirms gold overtook the euro as the world's second reserve asset in 2024 — gold 20% of official reserves, the euro 16%, the dollar down to 46%.
items.text: The ECB's own report confirms gold overtook the euro as the world's second reserve asset in 2024 — gold 20% of official reserves, the euro 16%, the dollar down to 46%. The oldest money on Earth outranks the newest major currency on the world's books. Nobody voted; the central banks just bought.

items.title: The PBoC reports its twentieth straight month of gold buying — 14.93 tonnes in June, the biggest monthly add since 2023, holdings near 2,346 tonnes.
items.text: The PBoC reports its twentieth straight month of gold buying — 14.93 tonnes in June, the biggest monthly add since 2023, holdings near 2,346 tonnes. Through every stablecoin ban and every digital-yuan launch, the metal purchase never stopped once.

items.title: The Shanghai Gold Exchange opens its first offshore vault, in Hong Kong, with yuan-denominated, Hong-Kong-deliverable gold contracts.
items.text: The Shanghai Gold Exchange opens its first offshore vault, in Hong Kong, with yuan-denominated, Hong-Kong-deliverable gold contracts. Chinese gold pricing steps outside the mainland for the first time — in yuan, not dollars.

items.title: The NFRA lets ten insurers — China Life, Ping An, PICC — buy gold on the Shanghai Gold Exchange, up to 1% of assets.
items.text: The NFRA lets ten insurers — China Life, Ping An, PICC — buy gold on the Shanghai Gold Exchange, up to 1% of assets. A potential 200-billion-yuan institutional bid, switched on by regulation. The state doesn't just buy gold; it orders the savings pool to.
kv: Beijing Sends the Insurance Money Into Gold

items.title: The 2026 Monetary Policy Statement drops the hard 2030 de-dollarization deadline for a conditions-based road to ZiG-only money — inflation at 4.1%, the first single-digit print in a …
items.text: The 2026 Monetary Policy Statement drops the hard 2030 de-dollarization deadline for a conditions-based road to ZiG-only money — inflation at 4.1%, the first single-digit print in a generation, but reserves at a fraction of target. New gold-backed banknotes launch the same day. The gold currency lives, on probation.
kv: Zimbabwe Trades Its Deadline for Conditions

items.title: Ghana closes 2025 with the cedi up roughly 41% against the dollar — the world's best currency — reserves up from $9 to $13.8 billion, GoldBod having exported 104 tonnes.
items.text: Ghana closes 2025 with the cedi up roughly 41% against the dollar — the world's best currency — reserves up from $9 to $13.8 billion, GoldBod having exported 104 tonnes. The Finance Ministry credits the gold monopoly for the appreciation. The metal pole's cleanest win anywhere on Earth.

items.title: Mahama signs the Gold Board Act: the new state GoldBod gets the exclusive right to buy, grade and export all artisanal gold.
items.text: Mahama signs the Gold Board Act: the new state GoldBod gets the exclusive right to buy, grade and export all artisanal gold. The state seizes its own gold trade whole. Within a year the cedi is the best-performing currency on Earth.

items.title: German economists and lawmakers — including a former Bundesbank official — renew public calls to bring home the 1,236 tonnes at the New York Fed, citing custody risk under Trump.
items.text: German economists and lawmakers — including a former Bundesbank official — renew public calls to bring home the 1,236 tonnes at the New York Fed, citing custody risk under Trump. The Bundesbank declines. France already quietly moved everything; Germany is still asking.
kv: Germany Asks for Its Gold Back

items.title: The Czech National Bank board approves studying a bitcoin reserve — up to 5% floated.
items.text: The Czech National Bank board approves studying a bitcoin reserve — up to 5% floated. Lagarde rejects it publicly the same day: no bitcoin in any EU central-bank reserve. Prague later buys a one-million-dollar test portfolio anyway. The bloc's only central-bank crypto-reserve move, strangled in the crib and still twitching.
kv: Prague Floats a Bitcoin Reserve and Lagarde Kills It

items.title: The Bank of Russia begins selling physical gold from reserves for the first time, to plug the budget deficit — nearly 22 tonnes gone by the end of Q1 2026, holdings on a 24-year-low …
items.text: The Bank of Russia begins selling physical gold from reserves for the first time, to plug the budget deficit — nearly 22 tonnes gone by the end of Q1 2026, holdings on a 24-year-low trajectory. The one great power selling while every other central bank buys. War finance eats the hoard.

items.title: A gold-linked settlement pilot called the Unit launches — 40% gold, 60% BRICS-currency basket, on Cardano, run by a research institute.
items.text: A gold-linked settlement pilot called the Unit launches — 40% gold, 60% BRICS-currency basket, on Cardano, run by a research institute. Headlines call it the BRICS gold currency; no summit ever endorsed it, no member government signed. Filed here because the hype itself is the signal: the world wants to believe a gold settlement layer is coming.
kv: The Gold Unit That Wasn't BRICS

items.title: Brazil's central bank buys 16 tonnes of gold in September — the start of a three-month, 43-tonne run that doubles gold's share of reserves while the dollar share hits a record low.
items.text: Brazil's central bank buys 16 tonnes of gold in September — the start of a three-month, 43-tonne run that doubles gold's share of reserves while the dollar share hits a record low. The BRICS anchor hedges in metal while Washington aims a tariff at its payment rail.

items.title: Finance Minister Kato says on television that Japan's US Treasury holdings — the world's largest — "exist as a card" in the trade talks with Washington.
items.text: Finance Minister Kato says on television that Japan's US Treasury holdings — the world's largest — "exist as a card" in the trade talks with Washington. Two days later in Milan he walks it back: not considering a sale. The card was shown, then put back in the deck.
kv: Japan Says the Quiet Part About Its Treasuries

items.title: Prabowo launches the country's first bullion banks — BSI and Pegadaian, licensed for gold deposit, financing, trading and custody — to keep mined gold onshore.
items.text: Prabowo launches the country's first bullion banks — BSI and Pegadaian, licensed for gold deposit, financing, trading and custody — to keep mined gold onshore. The world's archipelago of gold mines decides its metal should bank at home.
kv: Indonesia Builds Its First Bullion Banks

items.title: Withdrawal queues at the Bank of England's vault stretch from days to four-to-eight weeks as roughly 393 tonnes flee London for Comex New York on tariff fears.
items.text: Withdrawal queues at the Bank of England's vault stretch from days to four-to-eight weeks as roughly 393 tonnes flee London for Comex New York on tariff fears. A physical run on the world's second-largest gold vault — met with explanations, not policy. The metal moved west before the tariffs even landed.
kv: The Gold Runs From London to New York

Headlines in the record are editorial; each card leads with the record's own first sentence.

International room exception: rows may keep news links. Every row's url is the single link the page showed; 163 of the 164 page cards were labelled 'Reconstructed (not an official filing)' and 1 'Saved link'. Treat row urls as source_kind news unless the host is an official body.
